description:
Bounded PR A acceptance: establish trusted kind for explicitly supported first-release paths and prove nonmention capture; fail closed/mark unsupported elsewhere. Exhaustive provider enrichment is optional follow-up, not blanket A blocker. Document supported matrix and split residual enhancements.

## Current delivery contract — user-approved two-outcome stack
Owner: PR A. One PR per complete outcome, NOT one PR per bead. Keep detailed beads and cohesive internal commits for tracking; consolidate existing draft foundations into their owning feature PR where practical. PR B stacks on independently usable PR A. Include owning PR documentation and validation there. This supersedes earlier per-bead/prerequisite PR instructions and historical comments. Closed foundation status is not outcome acceptance.
New-feature E2E requires explicit human UX approval in zaq-emb.12; no self-approval.

Follow-up to .14.2.1 discovered during adapter review: Jido.Chat.ChannelMeta defaults is_dm=false without proving a room; shared-history stamping therefore remains nil for typed metadata without explicit room type. Audit supported Mattermost/Slack/Teams/Discord/Telegram adapter event facts at the verified event origin, normalize explicit channel/group type or adapter-confirmed DM before bridge routing, and keep missing/unknown kinds fail-closed. Do not use untrusted webhook is_dm/metadata, fallback false or a first connector guess. Tests FIRST with real provider event fixtures and cross-provider/config mismatch, including nonmention passive capture readiness; keep channel-specific code in Channels. No new Action/tool or E2E authoring; consult Channels guide and Action reuse.

comments.text: Action reuse: no independent operation; normalize provider-origin room type as a private Channels bridge guard in existing JidoChatBridge.to_internal/2 and listener ingress, with existing Jido.Chat.* adapters as sole producers. Jido.Chat.ChannelMeta.is_dm defaults false; upstream Mattermost maps unknown channel_type to :channel and Discord missing guild_id to :dm, so metadata alone may misstate an unknown event. Inputs: normalized adapter Incoming + configured provider/room and original raw provider event facts; outputs: :direct/:channel/nil fail-closed, no grants or persistence, deterministic/idempotent. No agent tool or workflow Action: local-only policy normalization is not a composable business operation. Tests first: real provider event fixtures for Mattermost/Discord/Telegram, conflicting claimed metadata, unknown types, nonmentions, configured provider mismatch. Supported first-release matrix must be explicit; Slack/Teams not configured in config/config.exs. No dependency edits and no outbound changes.
